notes.note: "This day was published, in 1 Vol. 18mo. printed on fine wove paper, with the best ink, and hot-pressed, price 5s. bound in red, a new, corrected, and enlarged edition of Charles Jones's Hoyle's Games Improved...Of whom may be had, lately published 1. In 18mo. price 3s. 6d. in a case like an Almanack, Hoyle's Games Improved, selected as a Companion to the Card-table...2. In 12mo. price 6d. sewed, The Essay on Game Cocks."
